statement.text: Cache pressure alone is insufficient to reproduce the synthetic service failure.

sources.passage: Raising cache pressure under fixed request volume did not reproduce the failure.

uncertainty.description: The result weakens the prior single-factor hypothesis but does not identify the true mechanism.

assumptions: The synthetic manipulation materially changed cache pressure and measurement was functioning.
competing_hypotheses: Failure requires interaction between cache pressure and request volume.
Another variable explains both observed cache pressure and failure.

experiment.description: Increase cache pressure while holding request volume constant.

results.result: No service failure occurred during the synthetic test.

missing_information.reason: The negative result rejects sufficiency but does not identify the remaining causal mechanism.
